title: Tidy the feed helpers and the sync module
description: Housekeeping ahead of the per-depot work. The cell helpers move out of `parse.ts` into `cells.ts`, so the depot parser can share them without importing the whole parser; `key()` moves to the top of reconcile beside the types it keys; main starts the status server beside the state it serves instead of after the sync closure; and a couple of function bodies are reordered so their declarations sit together. Should be behaviour-neutral.

commit.subject: Tidy the feed helpers and the sync module
commit.body:
cells.ts takes lines, normaliseSku and quantityOf; key() to the top of
reconcile; the status server beside its state in main.
